messages:
erin: Quick triage sync after the postmortem. Need final owners + short timelines for missing spans, bad aggregation, and ETL lag. I sketched a minimal plan below.

alex: LFG. I can pick up the span extractor work. Quick mitigation ready: bump heap + GC flags + consumer concurrency. Full fix = backpressure tokens + better batching.

maria: Aggregator double-count root cause confirmed: retried batches replaying increments. Plan: dedupe by (trace_id, span_id, batch_id) + a small sliding window store.

sam: ETL lag: bad partition rollout + occasional broker stalls. I reverted the rollout; adding `etl.partition.lag_95` alert and emergency reassign runbook.

erin: Proposed short action list (edit if needed):
- A: span extractor mitigation -> owner alex -> action: JVM bump + pin GC -> ETA: 6h for staging, 24h canary
- A2: full backpressure redesign -> owner alex -> ETA: 2026-04-10
- B: aggregator dedupe -> owner maria -> action: PR with dedupe cache + metrics `agg.dedupe.hits` -> ETA: PR 3d, canary 7d
- C: ETL partition stability -> owner sam -> action: rollback done + alert thresholds -> ETA: full tuning 2d

jules: I can be backup for A while alex is on-call next week.

ops-bot: deploy started by alex at 1835501280  span-extractor/jvm-bump -> staging

alex: Staging deploy in. Early signals: consumer lag down ~40%, heap pressure reduced. Monitoring `span.kv.misses` and GC pause durations.

maria: I'll add `agg.dedupe.replays` and `agg.dedupe.hits` to the metrics and include unit tests for duplicate increments. PR will include a small canary rollout plan.

erin: Also adding two systemic items: (1) chaos regression that simulates short GC pauses and asserts no span loss -> owner: maria -> ETA 2w, (2) weekly observability digest tile for `agg.dedupe.hits`, `span.kv.misses`, `etl.lag_95` -> owner: erin -> ETA 1w.

sam: Runbook note added for emergency partition reassign. I'll also instrument `etl.partition.idle_seconds` and surface a dashboard tile.

alex: Note that this GC->span-loss happened Jan + Feb. Treat as recurring class of failures; recommend adding alert and test coverage rather than ad-hoc fixes.

erin: Agreed. I'm locking owners in the postmortem doc and scheduling 15m daily checks at 09:15 PST for the next 3 days.

jules: I'll shadow alex during canary promotion and validate spans coverage.

alex: If `span.kv.misses` > 0.5% for 5min during canary, roll back.

erin: Draft customer blurb for support: "We've identified and mitigated the causes of recent span loss and aggregation discrepancies. Engineers have deployed mitigations and will roll out fixes; customers should see restored accuracy within 48 hours." Approve?

maria: fine by me.

sam: fine. Logs and snippets are attached to the postmortem doc (link).

erin: Perfect. I'll update the postmortem with timelines and owners, and ping support with the blurb once the staging signals stay green. Thanks all :thumbsup:
